name: menin 1

function.text: MEN1 encodes menin. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in DNA repair and transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Pulmonary carcinoid tumor; Thymic neuroendocrine tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: MEN1 encodes menin, a tumor-suppressor scaffold protein involved in histone modification and epigenetic regulation of gene expression. Menin helps organize protein interactions that alter chromatin structure and thereby influence transcription. Its scaffold role connects chromatin-associated regulatory proteins rather than specifying a single enzymatic reaction. Changes in these protein assemblies can affect multiple pathways through altered regulation of gene activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEN1 have been reported in adrenocortical carcinoma, pulmonary carcinoid tumor, and thymic neuroendocrine tumor.
